description: Bumps the versions pinned in programs/*/setup.sh and workflows (see the # renovate: comments there), programs/zed/config/.zed-version, the prek hook revs and the GitHub Actions. Runs from .github/workflows/renovate.yml, which also sets the schedule.

customManagers.description: VERSION="x.y.z" (shell) or VERSION: "x.y.z" (workflow env) lines annotated with: # renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [extractVersion=<regex>]
Zed app version: a bare x.y.z in its own file, read by programs/zed/setup.sh. Release tags are vX.Y.Z; the vX.Y.Z-pre previews don't match extractVersion and are skipped.

packageRules.description: Only patch bumps for the pyenv Python; move to a new minor series by hand.
